blocks.title: Worked example · Reject orphan reference
blocks.text: The DBMS rejects the foreign key value 12, unless a matching Customer row is created or the reference is changed. Policies for deleting parent rows may RESTRICT, CASCADE or SET NULL, where permitted and configured.

blocks.title: Write and space overhead
blocks.text: An index on ISBN can support quicker exact-match retrieval, especially for large data, but occupies space and requires maintenance after insert/update/delete. A UNIQUE constraint is appropriate if ISBN must be unique in this table.
